value.name: Daniel leaves the study
value.description: After Daniel's footsteps fade, the women remain alone in the study and stop performing for him.
evidence: After Daniel's footsteps had faded down the hall
the two of them held the study between them in a silence that no longer needed to perform itself for him

value.name: codicil remains unproven
value.description: The codicil question is still unresolved, though Rosa has identified the sheet as freshly written and the house clause has caught Asha's attention.
evidence: The codicil question had not resolved into proof
what sat on the desk was a folded sheet whose ink Rosa had quietly named fresh
whose paragraph naming the house had drawn her eyes the way water finds a low place

value.name: Asha remembers Lucia is upstairs
value.description: Asha recalls that Lucia is still in the house and senses Daniel will soon return to the room.
evidence: Asha remembered that Lucia was still in the house, still holding back whatever she had been holding back
and that Daniel would not stay out of this room for long

value.name: Asha asks where Lucia is
value.description: Asha quietly asks Rosa where Lucia is located.
evidence: Asha leaned a few inches across the desk, her hand still flat on the page, and asked Rosa under her breath where Lucia was.

value.name: Rosa confirms Lucia is upstairs
value.description: Rosa steadies herself at the tray and tells Asha that Lucia is upstairs and time is short.
evidence: she set her fingertips lightly on the edge of the tray as if to steady it
and said, almost without sound, that the girl was upstairs and that they had very little time

value.name: Asha hides the folded sheet
value.description: Asha pulls the folded sheet toward her side of the desk and covers the paragraph naming the house.
evidence: Asha slid the folded sheet a few inches toward her own side of the desk, away from the door
and let her palm rest over the paragraph that named the house

value.name: They silently agree Lucia must act soon
value.description: Without speaking directly about Lucia's secret, Asha and Rosa understand it must emerge within minutes or not at all.
evidence: Neither of them spoke about what Lucia had been keeping; it was understood now, between the tray and the desk, that whatever it was would have to come down the stairs in the next few minutes or not at all

value.name: Asha begins to speak to Rosa
value.description: Asha catches Rosa's eye and starts to say something in a near whisper.
evidence: Asha caught Rosa's eye across the desk and said, barely above
